Counting network-layer and data-link-layer visits across intermediate routers is OSI layering and packet forwarding — general data communications. Not web architecture (no HTTP/DNS/client-server), and no TECH1 or TECH2 unit covers networking layers.
LAN/MAN/WAN classification by transmission speed is general data communications and networking, which the 2026 syllabus does not contain.
Definition of a single-bit error is error detection in data transmission — general data communications, explicitly outside the 2026 syllabus.
Software process models (Waterfall, Spiral, V-model, Big Bang). The 2026 syllabus dropped software engineering entirely.

Software testing levels and software maintenance. Software engineering is absent from the 2026 syllabus.

sub: Concurrency control, locking and time stamping
why: Users mutually waiting on data each other has locked is deadlock arising from DBMS locking, i.e. concurrency control. Phrased in DBMS terms (users, locked data) rather than OS processes and resources.
